headline: Wardens Surge in Weathered Expanse; Gutter Front Reopens
war_summary: Day 601 of the war brings a Warden resurgence in the Weathered Expanse, where the flag count now reads six posts to one with two in ruin — a sharp swing from the even split of the last edition. Colonial raiders have answered elsewhere, establishing a foothold in the Gutter, where Suojus and Lost Kaivo changed hands into the evening. Linn Mercy's line holds at eight Colonial posts against three ruins, but its hourly toll has swollen to roughly twelve hundred Colonial and twenty-three hundred Warden even as base action there pauses. Palantine Berm remains the war's busiest seesaw at four Warden posts to three, sixty-one flag actions in a day with Vendett the busiest ground; Marban Hollow's Checkpoint Bua churns without rest alongside it. On the Farranac Coast, Transient Valley dropped to neutral at the filing hour as losses spiked sharply. The Nevish Line stands seven to one, Warden, its guns busy and its flags unmoved, while Mooring County and Callahans Passage have gone quiet. Thirty-four victory towns are required; no victor is named.
